ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and explore the potential for similar issues nationwide.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Are there similar issues in other states?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in Medicaid programs, highlighting the need for increased oversight and accountability.
